audited: film-engine-v2 working tree (branch react-components) on 2026-10-04; human summary in docs/v2-reuse-audit.md

capabilities.evidence: The desktop shell has two IPC channels only (fe-prompt, fe-prompt-answer, a synchronous prompt window). Everything else goes over HTTP to the bundled backend, which main.cjs starts or reuses by version. No writing-specific IPC is needed; the writing slice is HTTP + MCP.

Pages are React; origin/react-components is 44 commits ahead of this checkout (list controls, branding, engine moves). The Writing style workbench is not committed: it exists only as untracked files in the working tree (listed under uncommitted). Merging the two lines, and committing the workbench, come before shipping the writing UI.

film_projects, film_scripts, film_script_elements and film_screenplay_* tables carry the screenplay. Script revisions and change-safety are tested (8 and 15 subtests pass). There is no per-scene writing state; see scene-readiness.

Generated artefacts use a fingerprint-bound approval: 409 STALE_APPROVAL names what moved and returns a fresh envelope (21 subtests pass). ARTEFACT_KINDS covers media (keyframe, video, voice, lipsync, music, sfx, ambient, post, plates, scene_card) but not writing profiles: the writing store approves with human_confirmed and a DB state flip, outside that contract. GRD-4660 must bring profile approval onto the envelope.

Provider adapters, tiers and pricing are in place and tested, including an Anthropic adapter. The writing MVP deliberately makes no provider call: the attached assistant (ChatGPT or Claude) reads the context over MCP.

Generation jobs have idempotent handles, failed-job recovery and honest cancel (46, 12 and 9 subtests pass). There are no leases, heartbeats or a reconciliation sweep, which GRD-4568 asks for. The writing slice does not need durable jobs; Blender and stereo work do.

Provenance manifests are hashed (sha256 over the manifest) and stored in film_provenance_manifests; compliance and flow provenance tests pass. Portable asset storage as GRD-4571 defines it was not found. Writing provenance is separate: the profile context carries project, version, basis, evidence hash and sample ids.

MCP exposes writing_style_read, writing_style_examples, writing_style_context and writing_style_propose. Evidence confirmation and profile approval are not MCP tools, by design (a person approves). 30 and 9 subtests pass.

Not in committed v2. An MVP exists only as untracked files in the working tree (listed under uncommitted): immutable, revocable samples; versioned profile proposals; human approval; feedback; portable export and import. Its 11 backend subtests pass in the working tree (the Jira note says 12). It also fails bug-hunt-fixes there: server.js returns handleWritingStyle( without awaiting it. No sample enrolled and no profile activated. Commit it, with that fix, before building on it.

No per-scene Draft / Reviewing / Production ready state and no full-text fingerprint per scene exist in schema, migrations, lib or routes. text_fingerprint exists only for music cues. This is GRD-4671.

Camera blocking feeds the video payload without rewriting it (17 subtests pass), worlds have versions (film_world_versions) and the board lock holds every frame-writing path (7 pass). Saved editable Blender worlds with an approved camera, and staleness from world edits to boards, are not there yet: GRD-4665 and GRD-4666.
Resolve and FCPXML export, packaging with relocatable media, conform and the audio policy are tested (4, 8 and 12 subtests pass). Stereo (SBS) output does not exist: GRD-4667 to GRD-4669.

fixtures.name: nonzero-export-start
fixtures.gap: Nonzero SOURCE starts are held (a selected source trim matches Playback, the timeline route, conform and Premiere; invalid trims are refused). No fixture exports a timeline whose record start is not zero (for example a 01:00:00:00 start timecode). Kept as an explicit v2 gap for GRD-4669, where the SBS export must keep the exact edit mapping.
